text:
sasha: Heads-up — started seeing a cluster of schema validation 'noise' from fncall routes this morning. Small percentage of tool_call responses are failing structured-output checks but they're all different fields.
jonah: saw that. Is it one model or across variants?
sasha: looks across two variants (rxf-4 and rxf-4-compact), mostly when `tool` objects are nested under `result.content`.
maria: any example payloads we can look at? need to know whether this is actual corruption or just slight shape drift.
sasha: pasted a redacted sample from Sentry + telemetry below. note error_signature grouping we added: `missing.field:tool.name` and `type_mismatch:tool.params`.

``` 
telemetry_event = {
  "route": "/v1/chat/fncall",
  "model": "rxf-4",
  "schema_id": "tool_call_v3",
  "schema_version": "2026-11-03",
  "error_signature": "missing.field:tool.name",
  "soft_reject": true,
  "sample_payload_id": "samp_01F...",
  "count": 7
}
```

jonah: interesting we set `soft_reject` true for rollouts, so client still gets response but console flags it. That makes telemetry noisy by design.
eva: are these coming from a single customer or many? because cost of storing samples grows fast.
sasha: multi-tenant; top 3 customers account for ~60% of these events. Some are legitimate malformed outputs from prompt templates.
maria: could be prompt-engineered tool outputs that intentionally omit `name`. We should surface an aggregated dashboard: error_signature, route, model_variant, rollout_id.
prod-ux: agreed — current rollouts page just shows a toggle and a primitive error counter. We need example samples inline with a quick 'why' indicator (e.g., "missing required field -> likely template change"). Clicking a signature opens a diff view: expected vs actual.
jonah: infra question: we already emit `error_signature` but not `schema_hints`. Can we add `schema_hints` in the next rollout to help categorize? e.g., expected_path `/tool/name` vs actual path `/command/metadata/name`.
sasha: +1. Also thinking about sampling strategy: 1) keep deterministic first N samples per hour per route, 2) probabilistic sampling by severity, 3) adaptive sampling for new signatures.
eva: for retention policy — keep full samples for 7 days, aggregated counts forever. Cost roughly: 7 days * 50k samples * avg 5KB => ~350MB/day. Acceptable?
jonah: sounds fine but we need opt-out for customers on Dedicated/Private. Some contracts prohibit storing PII.
sasha: infra-bot: "scheduled job created: schema-sample-pruner (retention 7d, threshold 50k/day)" :robot_face:
infra-bot: "alert: high-cardinality schema signatures detected on /v1/chat/fncall. Cardinality=312. Recommended: enable signature hashing and low-freq bucketization."
maria: on the API shape debate — do we add `schema_version` to the response metadata for every fncall so consumers can make smarter fallbacks? That would avoid guessing.
jonah: pros: makes rollouts safer; cons: additional contract bloat and might encourage consumers to depend on internals.
prod-ux: UX idea: in Rollouts -> when `soft_reject` is enabled show a badge "schema noise" with a quick checklist: "most common signatures, sample example, toggle auto-fix suggestions". Clicking a signature opens a diff view: expected vs actual.
sasha: technical ask: we need an endpoint to fetch last N failing samples by error_signature and route. Suggest: GET /internal/telemetry/schema-samples?route=/v1/chat/fncall&signature=missing.field:tool.name&limit=25. Authenticated for SRE/devex only.
jonah: implementable. Will also add a lightweight hash in index to avoid full-text scan.
eva: what about quota interactions? we've seen spikes where schema noise correlates with transient retries. Could be a cascading retry on the client side. We should correlate with per-route rate-limit buckets and show that on the dashboard.
maria: quick mitigation: expand tolerant parsing in the console preview UI (treat missing `tool.name` as "unknown_tool") so users see content rather than an opaque error. But preserve strict enforcement server-side.
sasha: ok action items: 1) telemetry: add `schema_hints` and `schema_version` to events (jonah). 2) sampling: implement deterministic-first-N + adaptive sampling (jonah+eva). 3) rollout UX: add "schema noise" badge + sample diff view (prod-ux + maria). 4) console preview tolerant parse fallback (maria). 5) data retention + opt-out for Dedicated/Private (eva).
jonah: I'll open a PR for the telemetry schema change and a proposal doc for sampling algorithm. ETA EOD Friday.
sasha: thanks. If anyone hits a critical customer report ping me and I'll escalate.
prod-ux: can we slot a quick mock review on Monday? 15m.
sasha: done. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:
